The reader report is written to [research/frontier-18-reader-2.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-18-reader-2.md). I repaired the fatal quasi-isometry defects in batch 2: the two choice-dependent bridge items now state AC explicitly, the separated-net theorem now uses a Zorn argument instead of an unlicensed “choose a net” step, the downstream quasi-isometry items were rewritten to use direct choice-free quasi-inverse arguments where available, and the word/path-metric cluster no longer misquotes the ultrametric axiom.

I also updated [research/frontier-18-batch-2.proof-contracts.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-18-batch-2.proof-contracts.json). On the repaired set, `reflow` and `precheck` pass; `proof-contract --strict` passes on the full batch (`114/114`); and `citation-fidelity` passes on the full batch. No stale `verification.judge` blocks were present on the changed draft items. The report records the exact coverage note and the 31 item files I personally opened.
